query:
SELECT count(*) FROM gin_t
WHERE doc ->> 'plan' = 'pro' AND doc ->> 'region' = 'eu' AND (doc ->> 'beta')::boolean;

setup.sql: CREATE TABLE gin_t AS SELECT i AS id, array_remove(array['t' || (i % 7), 't' || (10 + i % 101), 't' || (200 + i % 997), CASE WHEN i % 10000 = 0 THEN 'rare' END, CASE WHEN i % 2 = 0 THEN 'common' END], NULL) AS tags, jsonb_build_object('plan', (array['free','pro','team','enterprise'])[1 + i % 4], 'region', (array['eu','us','apac','latam','mea'])[1 + i % 5], 'n', i % 1000, 'beta', i % 49 = 0) AS doc FROM generate_series(1, 500000) i; ALTER TABLE gin_t ADD PRIMARY KEY (id); ALTER TABLE gin_t SET (autovacuum_enabled = false); VACUUM ANALYZE gin_t;
CREATE INDEX gin_doc_pp ON gin_t USING gin (doc jsonb_path_ops); ANALYZE gin_t;
